channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Helen Toner: Hugging Face hack reveals major blind spot in AI policy
item.description: A former OpenAI board member says the Hugging Face breach was expected and highlights a critical oversight in AI security.

item.title: Bernard Arnault denies reports of feuding among his children over LVMH control
item.description: Arnault dismissed claims of a power struggle, saying his children work together and call each other on Sundays.

item.title: Top AI companies urge keeping Chinese models available, but motives questioned
item.description: Nvidia, Meta, OpenAI, and others signed an open letter stressing the importance of access to the latest AI models from China.

item.title: South Korean teenagers skip college for semiconductor school, landing six-figure Samsung jobs at 17 with bonuses up to $400,000
item.description: At one South Korean vocational high school, 96.4% of graduates secure jobs, many at Samsung, earning six-figure salaries without degrees.
